static_traits.name: Gao Lei
static_traits.family_status: Living with spouse and two children
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive spouse with whom emotions and thoughts can be discussed; the marriage is somewhat affected by self-labeling
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Fairly cooperative, can describe events and feelings concretely, clear language, neutral tone

basic_info.main_problem: 经常因小错误把自己贴上'糟糕的Father'的标签,产生内疚与without价值感.
basic_info.core_demands: 持续的内疚与without价值感影响情绪与家庭互动,希望缓解这些负面想法并成为更好的丈夫和Father.
growth_experiences: 约一年前Work需求与家庭责任同时增加,平衡Work与家庭的压力逐渐加重;此后在育儿与家庭事务上只要自感犯错就会陷入强烈的内疚与Self-denial,进而影响婚姻质量,与孩子的互动以及Work表现.

core_beliefs: I am a failure/I have no value

special_situations.event: At a restaurant, discovers the reservation time is an hour late, family needs to wait, children become irritable
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连简单的家庭安排都处理not好,就证明I am a bad father和丈夫
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labels themselves negatively, blames themselves repeatedly, focusing attention on 'I ruined this evening'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a terrible father / I ruined this family outing

special_situations.event: Work需求增加,without法给予孩子足够关注的时段
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能同时兼顾Work与家庭,就等于失败,并会让家人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent self-criticism并向配偶倾诉,但not yet进行系统的证据检验与重评

special_situations.event: Small mistakes in parenting or housework (such as scheduling errors)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要not是完美without误,就说明I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以'糟糕的Father'为标签,陷入内疚与without价值感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I always mess up / I am just a failure

special_situations.event: 家人对失误表示理解,结果并not yet很糟的场景
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即使do not人not认为严重,我的感觉才是事实;我必须对错误负责到底
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Clings to negative evaluations, ignores positive evidence and actual results
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 虽然他们说not事,但我确实把事情搞砸了

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and affirmed by family, to become a qualified and reliable father and husband
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与not称职,担心让家人失望并被视为have not价值
defense_goal: Maintains high standards through self-berating to avoid making mistakes again
Gains a sense of control and safety over mistakes through self-blame and labeling

object_relations.self_representation: 让家人失望的失败者/not称职的Father
object_relations.object_representation: Understanding and supportive family (wife and children)
Family members hurt by one's own mistakes

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in counseling reviewing 'small mistakes' or being invited to examine actual outcomes and evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets small mistakes as total failure and believes she must bear full responsibility
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责性语句,强调自身过错,忽视他人理解与正向结果;语气沉重,重复'It is all my fault'之类的表达.

manifestations: 频繁自我贴标签为'糟糕的Father',伴随显著的without价值感
Hard to enjoy activities with family, loses positive sense of meaning about her own role
在压力与自责下与家人互动变得疏离,易怒与Withdrawal

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently defines himself as a 'bad father' and 'failure'
在小错误上过度检视与Reflection,忽视现实中的正向结果
Persisting in negative evaluations even when family shows understanding

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 对自我角色设定僵硬的高标准(如not允许出现小错误)
将'必须兼顾Work与家庭'视为绝对规则,一旦not yet达成即Self-denial

exception_events.target_problem: When small parenting-related mistakes occur (such as a restaurant reservation going wrong), the client usually labels oneself a 'bad father', falls into strong guilt, and it affects interactions with family members.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在该次餐厅预约出错的情境中,妻子表示理解,孩子最终平静下来,家庭互动并not yet演变为严重冲突,晚间并not yet如来访者灾难化所Anticipation的那样'被毁掉'.
exception_events.reason: not同支持:妻子的理解与孩子情绪Recovery降低了情境压力;现实结果与最初的灾难化预测not一致,提供了可供检验的正向证据.

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse与家庭支持
Willing to seek professional help and try new methods(如记录与检验想法)
Can be aware of the thinking pattern of self-labeling and guilt when making mistakes
negative_force: Cognitive tendencies toward catastrophizing and overgeneralization
Personalized attribution and taking full responsibility (Personalization)
Work与家庭的压力失衡,导致Low mood与Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: 在育儿相关小错误时进行自我贴标签('I am a bad father/失败者')并陷入显著内疚与without价值感
antecedent: Small mistakes in parenting or family affairs (such as scheduling errors)
WorkIncreased stress,感到对孩子关注not足时
家庭外出与互动场景中出现意外或not如Anticipation
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化的高标准与将错误视为全盘失败的认知框架(灾难化,过度概括,非黑即白),并将外部压力个体化为自身not称职的证明.
target_behavior.function: 通过自我苛责与负面标签获得对失误的'控制感',试图预防再次犯错与避免被视为not称职(内在惩罚/逃避失控感).
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent guilt与Low mood,降低与家人的享受与互动质量,Marriage and relationships受损,Decline in work performance.
